newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn coalition may delay VAT hike decision - Hintze.
newsitem.headline: Bonn coalition may delay VAT hike decision - Hintze.

text.p: Germany's tax reform commission, due to finish its talks on Thursday, may postpone a decision on whether to increase value-added tax, a top colaition official said on Tuesday.
The size of a VAT hike should be decided in connection with social insurance reforms, Peter Hintze, general secretary of Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrats (CDU) said on German television.
The issue of the ratio between direct and indirect taxes is broader than the question of tax reform, Hintze said. "Whether we get that done on Thursday, we will have to see," he said.
A heated debate over the size of the VAT increase has strained Kohl's coalition.
Finance Minister Theo Waigel on Monday called for a one percent rise, while others in the CDU have sought a larger jump to reduce social insurance costs.
